mostWorthwhile.text: Following seawater into fractures, through heated rock and back into the sea made the circulation loop clear, including how it carries dissolved material.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial sequence was straightforward, with only one combination offered at each step, so it involved little decision-making.

surprise.text: Mixing the plume with cooler seawater dispersed it rather than producing the deposit I expected; cooling the returning fluid directly produced precipitation.

arbitrary.text: The distinction between the two cooling combinations was not obvious to me beforehand, although their results clarified the different outcomes.

continue.text: Yes. The circulation story connected familiar water movement to less familiar rock chemistry, and I would be curious to see another natural process explained this way.
